nodes.summary: A 0-1 integer programming instance $(n, A, b)$ is well formed when the right-hand side list $b$ has as many entries as there are rows of the coefficient matrix $A$, and every row of $A$ has exactly $n$ entries.
nodes.title: Well-formed 0-1 integer programming instances

nodes.summary: The decision problem 0-1 INTEGER PROGRAMMING FEASIBILITY belongs to NP, and every decision problem in NP has a polynomial-time many-one reduction to it.
nodes.title: 0-1 INTEGER PROGRAMMING FEASIBILITY is NP-complete

nodes.summary: The decision problem 0-1 INTEGER PROGRAMMING FEASIBILITY accepts a bitstring $x$ exactly when $x$ decodes, under the canonical bitstring encoding, to a 0-1 integer programming instance that is well formed and feasible; it rejects every bitstring that does not decode to such an instance.
nodes.title: 0-1 integer programming feasibility as a decision problem

nodes.summary: A 0-1 integer programming instance is a triple $(n, A, b)$ consisting of a natural number $n$ (the number of variables), a coefficient matrix $A$ given as a list of rows, each row a list of pairs of natural numbers, and a right-hand side $b$ given as a list of pairs of natural numbers. can_prove.label: ready to prove
can_prove.meaning: Statement is in Lean and nothing it needs is blocked, so the proof can start.

can_state.label: ready to state
can_state.meaning: Everything its statement uses is in Lean, so the statement can be written in Lean.

conditional.label: conditionally proved
conditional.meaning: Proof compiles, but rests on an open statement without a recorded Lean proof.

fully_proved.label: fully proved
fully_proved.meaning: Proved, and every prerequisite is fully proved too.

inventory_checked.label: inventory checked
inventory_checked.meaning: Module inventory checked in full; it records inspection, not a mathematical proof.

inventory_pending.label: inventory pending
inventory_pending.meaning: Module inventory not yet checked in full; it records inspection, not a mathematical proof.

not_ready.label: not ready
not_ready.meaning: Needs more blueprint work before it can be attempted.

proved.label: proved
proved.meaning: Proof compiles, but something it rests on is not finished.

stated.label: statement formalized
stated.meaning: Statement is in Lean; the proof is not.
